title: Causes of Accidental Deaths The total accidental deaths recorded during 1982 have been classi- fied under two broad categories: (A). Accidental Deaths due to natural causes like lighting, heat strokes, floods, land slides, cold and exposure and cyclone, and (B) Accidental deaths due to other causes like mishaps in factoreis, road accidents, air crashes, house collapse and boat capsizing. Category (A) accounted for 3 -6 per cent of total accidental deaths recorded in 1982incomparisonto 3 ‘3 percentin 1981. Under this category, the maximum number of deaths in 1982 were due to ‘Lightning’ (1754) followed by ‘Floods’ (699) ‘Land Slides’
